capabilities: Move the cursor to the start of text after indentation and Markdown markers
Toggle on repeat between text start and the absolute line beginning
Recognize lists, task lists, ordered lists, quotes, headings and footnotes
Bind either the Normal or Advanced command to any hotkey
disambiguation: Not a key remapper; it provides two commands that you bind to a hotkey yourself, such as Control+A or the physical HOME key.
extras: README warns that binding the Advanced command directly to the physical HOME key is at your own risk, lists known limitations (logical-line movement only, no support inside table cells), and names Universal Cursor Hotkeys as its successor, which adds visual-line HOME steps, in-table-cell support and Emacs-style navigation.
problem: Obsidian's HOME key goes to the absolute left edge of the line instead of the start of the text content after indentation and Markdown markers.

relations.evidence: Universal Cursor Hotkeys is the successor to this plugin

summary: Cursor command that moves to the beginning of text, skipping Markdown syntax like list markers, quotes, headings and footnotes.
